'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Haid DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die]]
* '''Username:''' Xonth
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
